removed_assertion.text: the daemon recorded the refusal as a durable policy denial
removed_assertion.reason: Impossible. agent-host/acp-host.ts dispatchToEngine calls input.assertAllowed before appendRecord(historyEntry('request.dispatched', ...)), so a refused method writes no history record at all. policy.denied exists only as a field of the AcpPolicySnapshot shape assertion, never as a history event. Replaced by asserting the refusal was never dispatched and that the durable initialize record is still present.

driver_defects_fixed: The overall deadline used setTimeout(...).unref() and only set process.exitCode, so the watchdog could never end the process: a run survived 16m48s past the 900s deadline with no children left, and the next run leaked a registry pid for 1h03m. The timer now reaps every recorded pid (SIGTERM then SIGKILL) and the registry through its own service entry, then process.exit(1); the timer is no longer unref'd.

A passing run also hung after printing PASS because the stopped daemons leave sockets and timers behind, so the event loop never drains. The driver now flushes stdout and process.exit's with its own verdict after reaping everything in the finally block.
